question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Consensus GAAP diluted EPS for Q3 2026 is $1.96-2.02. Guidance is $22.5-26.5B operating income, and Amazon usually beats the high end, so ~$28B op income gives core EPS ~$2.05-2.15. The main tail is a remeasurement of the Anthropic or OpenAI stakes: Q2 GAAP EPS was $5.75 with a $53.4B non-operating gain (mostly Anthropic). No priced Anthropic round turned up in Jul-Sep 2026 (IPO pushed to November), OpenAI's August tender was at its existing $852B valuation, and the $1.4T OpenAI round was only in talks on Sep 29, so I price ~12% on an observable-price gain pushing EPS above 2.995. Market check: no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market found.

- Searched for but not found: any priced Anthropic primary round or tender in Jul-Sep 2026; Rivian stake marks for Q3; Q3 severance/legal charges.
- Status quo: GAAP EPS near consensus plus a typical beat, unless Q3 contains an observable-price remeasurement of an AI stake. A gain of ~$13B pre-tax would add ~$0.95/share.

The Q1/Q2 GAAP spikes came from Anthropic observable-price remeasurements tied to priced rounds; no such round, tender or IPO occurred in Q3 (IPO targeted for November) and OpenAI's August tender was at its existing price, so I keep an 8% tail above $2.995 for an unseen transaction or note conversion. No credible mechanism for EPS below $0.995. Market check: only a thin (~$2k) Polymarket beat/miss contract whose line the runs disagree on ($2.00 vs $1.65); used as evidence, not an anchor. calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the facts: GAAP diluted EPS, Q3 guidance $22.5-26.5B op income, consensus $1.96-2.03, ~10.9B diluted shares, and no Anthropic priced round/tender/IPO in Q3 (IPO targeted for November). I could not verify independently, having no web access. Disputes: (1) Median $2.05-2.08. Run 1's own figure of ~$1.88 Q2 comparable EPS ex-Anthropic at $27.5B op income still included ~$2.7B of other gains, so I put the median slightly lower, at $2.03. (2) Upper-tail mass 7-12%. This is judgment: with no identified Q3 pricing event, an escape needs an unseen transaction or note conversion, so I took 8%, near runs 2 and 3. (3) The Polymarket contract line ($2.00 vs $1.65) cannot be settled here; it is a thin beat/miss contract and not an anchor either way. No lower escape is declared because no mechanism exists.
